name: hits
author: a20d8c29
description: Ranks nodes by Kleinberg's HITS algorithm, which gives every node two scores: an authority score, high when many good hubs point at it, and a hub score, high when it points at many good authorities. Computed by power iteration on the mutually recursive definition. Use it for questions about the best hubs and the best authorities in a directed network, such as 'which airports are the best connecting hubs?', 'which pages are the most authoritative?' or 'who are the biggest aggregators here?'. Prefer pagerank for plain overall importance; use hits when the question distinguishes pointing-to from being-pointed-at. Works on directed and undirected graphs, and uses edge weights when present; on an undirected graph the hub and authority scores are identical. Returns the top_k nodes, each with both scores.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, for example 'airports'. Use list_graphs to see the available graphs.

top_k.description: How many top-ranked nodes to return, from 1 to 100.

rank_by.description: Which score orders the results: 'authority' for the most pointed-at nodes, or 'hub' for the best pointers. Both scores are returned either way.

max_iter.description: Maximum number of power-iteration rounds before giving up, from 1 to 10000.

tol.description: Convergence tolerance: iteration stops when the total change in hub scores falls below this. Must be between 0 and 1.

use_weights.description: Whether to weight links by edge weight on a weighted graph. Set false to treat every edge as weight 1.
